title: BST260 Final Project Proposal
text: datasets analyzed project include CDC Firearm Mortality, RAND Gun Legislation, CDC Homicide Mortality. research investigates whether firearm mortality rate (death counts per 100,000 total population, adjusted population size age distribution state) United States 2014 2022 impacted number restrictive permissive legislative changes. three datasets provide information population within 50 states special district United States. permissive legislative change defined new law makes accessing using firearms easier compared status quo. restrictive legislative change new law renders accessing using firearms difficult compared status quo. dataset gives effect label (“Permissive” “Restrictive”) LawID (unique code law dataset), LawID misses effect label. allows us obtain number permissive restrictive laws year, non-negative integers. continuous, numeric outcome variable average firearm mortality rate United States year. Given rates adjusted population size state, makes sense calculate overall rate U.S. year averaging state rates. can also first solve population size state dividing number deaths death rate. , can use total number deaths given year divided total population size year obtain overall death date. Since missing data 2014, considering timeliness data, analysis restricted 2014 2022. years unique, integer values. Based murders dataset, Michigan Georgia top 10 lists murder rate (murder counts per 100,000 population) state population proportion total U.S. population. Therefore, two states can large impact overall murder rate U.S. Given many murders committed using firearms, project plans take closer look potential association number permissive restrictive legislative changes, firearm mortality rates, murder rates two states. comparison purpose, murder rate also continuous, floating point variable. States coded factors graphing R. Potential confounders may associate firearm (murder) mortality rate number gun legislative changes include firearm ownership, economic condition, demographic characteristics (example, proportions biological sex birth), political climate.
